blocks.raw: > Akamai’s Certificate Provisioning System (CPS) allows you to self-provision and manage your Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) and Transport Layer Security (TLS) certificates. It supports all certificate options, including third party.
blocks.text: Akamai’s Certificate Provisioning System (CPS) allows you to self-provision and manage your Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) and Transport Layer Security (TLS) certificates. It supports all certificate options, including third party.
